narrative.overview:
The admin app reads as the shop's own enamel signboard, not a SaaS panel. A deep green shell frames a cream ground; every count sits on a painted plate with a heavy ink border and a thin inset keyline; one hot colour, vermilion, is spent on money owed and nothing else. Everything settled stays quiet green or ink. The world lives in palette, plates and type. There is no ornament, illustration or pattern.

Density is working-desk density: 56px list rows, 44px touch targets, one tap per action. Phone and desk are equal targets. On phone a green top bar and a bottom tab rail carry the shell; at 900px and up the rail becomes a fixed 216px left column.
keyCharacteristics: Green shell, cream ground, paper-white plates and cards.
Slab display face only for titles, the brand, and plate numerals; everything else is the system font.
Vermilion means money owed or expired, never decoration.
Ochre marks selection and the active nav icon; the keyboard focus ring is blue for contrast.

rules.name: The Money-Owed Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only where someone owes money or a membership has lapsed. If a thing is merely important, it is not vermilion.

rules.name: The Focus-Is-Blue Rule
rules.body: Ochre decorates focus-adjacent state (active nav, selection, header rule); the actual focus ring is blue #1c4fa0. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Plates-Only Rule
rules.body: The slab face is for titles, the brand, and plate numerals. Names, rows, buttons, labels and form text stay on the system font.

rules.name: The Taka Fallback Rule
rules.body: The Taka sign (U+09F3) is not in the Latin subset and falls back to the system font. It is accepted behaviour, so do not rely on the slab face to render it.

rules.name: The Mounted-Plate Rule
rules.body: A plate is an ink border, an inset 1px keyline at 22% opacity and a ground shadow. Do not add gradients or glossy effects.

dos: Do put every count on a plate, and keep the slab face to titles, the brand and plate numerals.
Do use vermilion only for money owed, EXPIRED and never-paid states, and failures.
Do keep the blue focus ring on all interactive elements; use ochre for selection, active nav and the phone header rule.
Do keep targets at 44px minimum and list rows at 56px.
Do set font-synthesis: none wherever Alfa Slab One is used.
donts: Don't use a grey sidebar, white KPI cards, or SaaS dashboard chrome.
Don't add flowers, peacocks, patterns or other ornament; the world is palette, plates and type.
Don't fill surfaces or buttons with ochre.
Don't use bold on the display face, or use it for body copy, row names or buttons.
Don't use vermilion for emphasis that is not about debt or a lapsed membership.
